name: Oxagon
verdict: Oxagon is the industrial city of NEOM, the giga-project fully owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of NEOM SC, the club owned by NEOM. Chain: Oxagon -> NEOM -> PIF -> Government of Saudi Arabia. Oxagon's original shirt deal ran to June 2026 (Football Business Journal, 2025-12-24); the official 2026-27 Adidas kit launch still shows OXAGON on the front. The pull request proposes serious: the record is saudi-executions-2025 (HRW + Amnesty, two sources); the link is oxagon-part-of-neom, neom-pif-ownership and pif-chaired-by-crown-prince (each two sources). Rating on hold for a maintainer.

why.text: Oxagon is the industrial city of NEOM, the Saudi giga-project fully owned by the Public Investment Fund, the state's sovereign wealth fund, which the Crown Prince chairs. Saudi Arabia executed at least 356 people in 2025, a record. The logo on NEOM SC's shirt is that state's money. That's called sportswashing.
